name: Notion
tagline: Notes, docs and databases in one workspace
description: Notion combines notes, documents and databases in one workspace. Its pricing page positions it as 'one tool to run your company', with Free, Plus, Business and Enterprise plans.
features: Notion AI (limited trial on Free and Plus)
Notion Agent and AI Meeting Notes (Business)
Custom Agents priced per Notion credit
audience: Students and educators (free Plus for 1 member)
strengths: Free Plus plan for students and educators with a school email
limitations: Free multi-member workspaces have a block limit (number not stated)
Free plan limits: 5 MB uploads, 7-day page history, 10 guests

plans.name: Plus
plans.note: Yearly billing is described as 'save up to 20%'; the yearly per-month price was not captured

plans.name: Business
highlights: Notion Agent, AI Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search (beta)
limits: 1,500 Standard credits and 500 Select credits per month

plans.name: Enterprise
highlights: Zero data retention with LLM providers

free.details: Single-member workspaces have unlimited pages and blocks. Limits: 5 MB uploads, 7-day page history, 10 external guests, 1 notion.site domain.

api.summary: Custom Agents are free to try, then $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits. Custom domains are $8 per month per domain billed annually or $10 monthly. Public API pricing is not stated.

pricing.regional: Prices are in USD. Customers in the EU, UK and other regions with mandatory refund rules may be eligible for refunds beyond the standard 72 hours.

verification.notes: Product active. USD, per seat/month: Free $0, Plus $10, Business $20 (recommended; includes 1,500 Standard and 500 Select credits a month), Enterprise custom; Pay monthly / Pay yearly toggle (save up to 20%) was not switched, so the yearly price is not recorded.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: One workspace where your team and AI agents work together

capabilities.title: Capture everything in one place
capabilities.text: Notion describes itself as a single system of record for what your team knows and does.

capabilities.title: Find answers quickly, with citations
capabilities.text: Ask a question and get an answer that shows where it came from.

capabilities.title: Automate work with agents
capabilities.text: Agents keep routine work running around the clock.

capabilities.title: Work alongside AI agents
capabilities.text: The page presents Notion as a workspace where teams and agents work together.

featureCards.name: Capture
featureCards.text: Bring notes, documents and the rest of your team's information into one system of record.

featureCards.name: Find
featureCards.text: Get answers across your workspace quickly, with citations.

featureCards.name: Automate
featureCards.text: Use agents to keep work moving, from reporting to triage.

featureCards.name: Templates
featureCards.text: Start from ready-made templates instead of a blank page.

featureCards.name: Learning resources
featureCards.text: Product tours, the Academy and the Help Center are linked from the Notion product page.

audienceDetail.text: Notion has a dedicated enterprise section on its product page.
A small-business section covers teams that want one tool to run the company.
The product page has a startup section and cites startups among its customers.
A developer section covers building your own tools on Notion.

scenarios.title: Triage product feedback
scenarios.text: Let an agent sort incoming feedback instead of doing it by hand.

scenarios.title: Resolve support tickets in Slack
scenarios.text: Use an agent to work through support requests that arrive in Slack.

scenarios.title: Respond to security alerts faster
scenarios.text: Automate the first steps when an alert comes in.

scenarios.title: Automate weekly reporting
scenarios.text: Have the weekly report put together on a schedule.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Get Notion free button, or download the app.
Browse Templates and the Product tours to see how teams set it up.
The Academy and Help Center explain the product in more depth.
Request a demo to talk to sales.
